description: This file defines the SnapshotStorage class, which manages frame and resource snapshots, including adding resources, frame snapshots, retrieving snapshots by name, finalizing resource sorting, and handling resource overrides within a trace analysis context.

classes.name: SnapshotStorage
classes.description: Manages storage and retrieval of frame and resource snapshots, including caching, sorting, and override handling.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a resource snapshot to a specific context, rewriting its URL.

methods.name: addFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Adds a frame snapshot and creates a corresponding renderer, handling resource overrides.

methods.name: snapshotByName
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot renderer by page or frame ID and snapshot name.

methods.name: snapshotsForTest
methods.description: Returns all stored frame or page IDs for testing purposes.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Sorts resources and updates override URLs to prevent stale content.

methods.name: hasResourceOverride
methods.description: Checks if a resource URL has an override.

methods.name: _ensureResourcesForContext
methods.description: Ensures resource array exists for a given context ID, creating it if necessary.
